headline: Astronomers Record Most Distant Fast Radio Burst
captionCards: New data helps map matter distribution in the early universe
instagramCaption:
Astronomers have identified the most distant fast radio burst ever recorded.

This discovery marks a significant milestone in space observation, pushing the boundaries of how far we can detect these fleeting cosmic signals. The finding provides new data points for understanding the early universe and the distribution of matter across vast cosmic distances.
